name: companions
description: First-party Claude/Codex companion bridges and companion discovery library per companions/contract.md v0.1.1

interface.longDescription: Script-only library plugin that bundles the canonical claude-companion and codex-companion CLIs along with the canonical companion discovery library (discover-peer.mjs). Consumer plugins discover the bundled scripts via cache-glob and invoke them per companions/contract.md v0.1.1 to run cross-host peer-agent ensembles.
